description:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wchill/rvx-morphed/compare/v5.14.1...v5.15.0

* Port updated reddit patches from https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches-arsclib.
    * `Hide sidebar components` patch added
    * `Spoof signature` patch added (fixes notifications)
    * `Unlock premium icon` patch removed
    * `Hide Recently Visited shelf` patch removed (it is integrated into `Hide sidebar components`)
    * Drop support for reddit app versions before v2025.40.0. Supported versions are v2025.40.0, v2025.43.0, v2025.45.0, and v2025.52.0.
    * General system stability improvements to enhance the user's experience
